title: A Comprehensive Survey of Reward Models: Taxonomy, Applications, Challenges, and Future
paper_type_zh: 奖励模型与偏好数据综述
best_for_zh: 需要厘清偏好对、标量奖励、奖励模型与裁判模型职责边界的读者。
one_line: A 2025 reward-model map that separates feedback collection, reward fitting, and downstream use.
梳理反馈收集、奖励建模、奖励使用与评测边界的 2025 年奖励模型综述。
why: Reward language is often overloaded; this survey routes readers to the actual data or verifier object they need to audit.
inclusion_reason: A current primer for distinguishing preference data, scalar rewards, reward models, and their evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Terms such as preference data, reward model, judge, and verifier are routinely conflated in post-training discussions. This 2025 survey at https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12328 maps reward models from preference collection through modeling and use to evaluation. It establishes the data lineage before readers enter feedback-data, reward, or judge-specific tracks. In particular, a preference pair, the policy that produced it, an annotator decision, and a learned score are different records with different failure modes. Treating them as one object makes provenance and reliability claims hard to interpret.
后训练讨论常把偏好数据、奖励模型、裁判模型和验证器混为一谈。该综述从偏好收集、建模、使用到评测梳理奖励模型的全流程：https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12328。读者首先应分清偏好对、生成回答的策略、标注决定和学习得到的分数；它们是不同记录，失效方式也不同。若把它们视为同一对象，就无法追查来源，也无法判断可靠性主张是否成立。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey treats a reward model as a learned proxy for preference, not as the preference record itself. It organizes the lifecycle into collection, modeling, usage, applications, and benchmarks, exposing the interfaces where annotation, aggregation, model fitting, and evaluation can fail. A useful audit boundary therefore preserves the prompt, candidates, feedback source, disagreement or aggregation rule, predicted reward, and the optimizer or selector that consumes it. This separation is the Card’s key routing lesson: a high reward-model benchmark score is neither a direct measurement of human preference nor a guarantee of safe downstream optimization.
该文将奖励模型界定为对偏好的学习代理，而非偏好记录本身。它把生命周期分为收集、建模、使用、应用和基准评测，从而暴露标注、聚合、拟合和评测各自可能出错的环节。审阅奖励管线时，应保留提示词、候选回答、反馈来源、分歧或聚合规则、预测分数，以及使用该分数的优化器或选择器。奖励模型在基准上得高分，既不等于直接测得人类偏好，也不保证下游优化安全。

title: Method
方法
html: It surveys datasets and methods through the reward-model lifecycle. When recording a reward-based pipeline, keep the prompt, compared responses, labeler or AI-feedback source, aggregation rule, reward output type, and optimization use as separate fields. Also record whether the feedback is pairwise, scalar, critique-based, or rule-based, and whether collection is offline or policy-dependent; otherwise two superficially similar datasets can be assigned the same label while supporting incompatible conclusions. Then route raw pairs to Track2, process rewards to Track4, programmatic signals to Track5, and judge reliability to Track11.
该文按奖励模型生命周期综述数据集和方法。记录奖励管线时，应分别保存提示词、被比较回答、标注者或 AI 反馈来源、聚合规则、奖励输出形式和优化用途；还要说明反馈是成对比较、标量评分、文字批注还是规则生成，以及收集是离线进行还是依赖当前策略。否则看似相近的数据集会被归为同类，却支持互不兼容的结论。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract explicitly covers preference collection, reward modeling, usage, applications, and evaluation benchmarks. It is evidence of a broad taxonomy, not validation of a particular reward dataset.
官方摘要明确覆盖偏好收集、奖励建模、使用、应用和评测基准。这只能证明综述的分类范围，并不能验证其中任何一个具体奖励数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html: RLHF and preference modeling predate this work. Its contribution is a current taxonomy that makes the feedback-to-model-to-optimizer chain explicit and includes benchmark evaluation. That update matters because recent systems use human feedback, AI feedback, process signals, and judge-like evaluators in overlapping roles; the taxonomy makes the overlap inspectable rather than collapsing it into “RLHF data.” It should not be read as evidence that a judge’s output is ground truth or that a reward-model score transfers unchanged across prompts, policies, and optimization settings.
RLHF 与偏好建模早于该文。它的贡献在于用当下的分类框架明确呈现“反馈—模型—优化器”的链条，并将基准评测纳入其中。近期系统常让人工反馈、AI 反馈、过程信号和类裁判评估器承担重叠角色；该框架使这种重叠可以逐项核查，而非笼统称作“RLHF 数据”。它不能证明裁判模型输出天然等于真值，也不能证明奖励模型分数可在不同提示词、策略和优化设置之间原样迁移。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The survey does not supply a license, split, or annotation audit for every referenced dataset. Reward-model performance can hide preference bias and reward hacking.
综述不会为每个被引数据集提供许可证、数据划分或标注审计；奖励模型的表面表现也可能掩盖偏好偏差和奖励投机。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey maps reward-model research across preference collection, model construction, usage, applications, and benchmarks. It distinguishes a preference record from a learned reward model and from the optimizer or evaluator that later consumes the model's output. No individual reward model or preference dataset is released.
综述将奖励模型研究梳理为偏好收集、模型构建、使用、应用和基准评测。它区分偏好记录、学习得到的奖励模型，以及后续使用模型输出的优化器或评估器。论文不发布单个奖励模型或偏好数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read collection before usage: a reward is only interpretable with its prompt distribution, label protocol, aggregation rule, and evaluation target.
奖励模型不是用来直接回答问题的模型，而是从人类或 AI 的比较、排序和评分中学习偏好的打分器。它把零散的反馈变成可以反复调用的分数，因此既能帮助训练模型，也能在多个候选答案之间作选择。这篇综述最值得记住的，是“收集反馈、训练奖励模型、使用奖励分数”是相连却不同的三件事；同一个高分也会随着反馈来源、任务和使用方式的变化而具有不同含义。
